description: Value a list of inventory lots of tracked products at melt (spot x metal content) and at today's median listed US dealer ask, with cost basis and unrealized gain against melt when you give it. Up to 50 lots. On REST pass lots as JSON or as sku:qty[:cost_basis] items joined by commas.

cost_basis_usd.description: Total cost of the lot in USD (optional).

product.description: Tracked product slug from list_products (for example american-silver-eagle-1oz) or a name with its weight. A name only matches a product of the same weight.

spot_gold.description: Optional spot price in USD per troy oz to use instead of Bullion Price Check's latest reading (gold-api.com). The answer labels it spot_source=caller.

spot_platinum.description: Optional spot price in USD per troy oz to use instead of Bullion Price Check's latest reading (gold-api.com). The answer labels it spot_source=caller.

spot_silver.description: Optional spot price in USD per troy oz to use instead of Bullion Price Check's latest reading (gold-api.com). The answer labels it spot_source=caller.

name: value_inventory
title: Inventory valuation
